label: adrJA005B2A
source_comment: A6/D0: clicked wall cell. Toggle its light, dispatch the current-tower record, then play sound 0; reference zero returns unchanged.

label: adrJB005B66
source_comment: No switch effect; return to caller. Also the base for Switches_LookupTable signed word displacements.

label: adrJT005B68
source_comment: Eight signed word displacements from Switch_00_s00_Null, indexed directly by the even action byte $00-$0E.

label: adrJA005CF8
source_comment: A1/D1: trigger record. Remove the target feature, then create a stone wall unless the retained flag blocks creation. Not switch action $00.

label: adrJA005CFC
source_comment: A1/D1: action record. Resolve CC/DD on the active floor; when second-byte bit 7 is clear, reset first-byte data and toggle space/stone wall.

label: adrCd005D10
source_comment: Return after the target-wall toggle or its flag check.

label: adrJA005D12
source_comment: A1/D1: action record. Clear the target type, also clearing decoration/facing if it was stone. A6/D0 returns the target; other flags survive.

label: adrCd005D26
source_comment: A6/D0: target cell. Clear second-byte type bits 0-2 and return; retain first-byte data and other flags.

label: adrCd005D2E
source_comment: A1: tower record block; D1: four-byte record offset. Read CC/DD; return D7=X:word/Y:word and A6/D0=target cell on the loaded floor. Clobbers A0.

label: adrCd006E90
source_comment: A6/D0: type-6 destination. Subtype 0 clears living champions worn spells; subtype 1 skips trigger dispatch; subtypes 2/3 execute the pad.

label: adrCd006EA0
source_comment: D1: nonzero floor subtype. Skip pit subtype 1; dispatch visible/invisible pads 2/3 using the destination in A6/D0.

label: adrCd006F80
source_comment: A5: party. Clear worn spells for living occupied slots and redraw the party panel. Preserve D0/D7/A6 for movement.

label: adrLp006F86
source_comment: D7: party slot 3 down to 0. Skip dead/unavailable slots and clear the living champion worn-spell byte at stat record +$11.

label: adrCd006F9A
source_comment: Continue the four-slot loop, redraw the party command panel, restore movement registers and return.

label: adrEA006FA8
source_comment: Signed word selecting post-trigger sound: negative suppresses playback, 0 is switch click, 1 door click, 5 alternative spell sound. Not a wait flag.

label: adrCd006FAA
source_comment: A5: party; A6/D0: pad cell; D7: movement X/Y. Choose default sound, dispatch the tower trigger record, then restore movement state, possibly rewritten by teleport.

label: adrCd006FC0
source_comment: A6/D0: pad cell. Return A1=current tower trigger block, D1=reference*4, D2=action byte. Select spell sound for actions $08/$0A/$2A.

label: adrCd006FF2
source_comment: Set the pending trigger sound to the alternative spell effect before dispatch.

label: adrCd006FF8
source_comment: A1/D1: record; D2: even action byte. Call the signed-offset handler with D0/D7/A6 saved; play the returned nonnegative TriggerSound_ID.

label: adrCd007012
source_comment: Pop dispatcher D0/D7/A6. Teleport and tower-entry handlers rewrite this saved frame so movement resumes at the destination.

label: adrJB007016
source_comment: Return without an effect. Also the base for Triggers_LookupTable signed word displacements and a shared RTS for other routines.

label: adrJT007018
source_comment: 31 signed word displacements from Trigger_00_t00_Null; the action byte is the byte offset $00-$3C, not an ordinal to double again.

label: adrJA007356
source_comment: Single-party return to the Keep: select the departing tower arrival floor/pair, store its midpoint, and replace saved dispatcher movement state.

label: adrJA007386
source_comment: Two-party return to the Keep: require a player party at record CC/DD, then place both parties on the corresponding Keep arrival pair.

label: adrCd0073A2
source_comment: Discard the saved trigger-record pointer and return after the opposite-pad player check fails.

label: adrCd0073A6
source_comment: A1: partner party; stack: trigger pointer. Save outgoing tower state; select Keep arrival floor and pair using the current tower.

label: adrJA0073E6
source_comment: Single-party tower entrance: BB selects a four-byte arrival pair, floor is zero, and the party appears at the pair midpoint.

label: adrCd007408
source_comment: A0/D0: arrival pair; D1: floor; A5: party. Store midpoint, select tower/map/floor, rewrite dispatcher D0/D7/A6, mark occupancy, unpack monsters.

label: adrJA007454
source_comment: A1/D1: trigger record. Require a player party at CC/DD; BB selects an arrival side. Negative MultiPlayer values return immediately.

label: adrCd00746E
source_comment: Discard the saved trigger-record pointer after the opposite-pad player check fails.

label: adrCd007470
source_comment: Return when the current game mode or opposite-pad occupancy prevents tower travel.

label: adrCd007472
source_comment: A1: partner party; stack: trigger pointer. Save outgoing state; use BB*2 as arrival-side offset and floor zero.

label: adrCd00748C
source_comment: A1: partner; A5: active party; A0/D0: arrival side; D1: floor. Place both parties, replace saved dispatcher movement state and load tower monsters.

label: adrJA007502
source_comment: Remove the record CC/DD target only when bit 0 is set in both first bytes at current tower map-cell offsets $14 and $1C.

label: adrJA00751A
source_comment: Run the ending display for the player interface or interfaces, present it through both screen buffers, then wait for the completion flag to clear.

label: adrJA007630
source_comment: A1/D1: record. XOR target first byte with 3: subtype 0 swaps with 3 and 1 with 2; ceiling-hole/reference bits and cell type are unchanged.

label: adrJA00763C
source_comment: BB: destination floor; CC/DD: X/Y. Try the target then one cell north, checking bit 7 only. On success update player and saved movement state; no flash.

label: adrCd007660
source_comment: D6: destination floor; D7: X/Y; A6/D0: destination cell. Call the shared commit helper and return without queueing a flash.

label: adrCd007664
source_comment: D6: floor; D7: X/Y; A6/D0: destination. Move occupancy and player position; rewrite dispatcher D0/D7 at SP+8/+12. Requires two nested return addresses.

label: adrJA007686
source_comment: BB: destination floor; CC/DD: X/Y. Try target then one cell east, checking bit 7 only. Commit player/saved movement state and queue a flash.

label: adrCd0076AC
source_comment: Commit destination D6/D7/A6/D0, then queue effect $10 at the arrival cell. Post-trigger sound remains selected by the dispatcher.

label: adrJA0076B4
source_comment: A1/D1: record. Advance target second-byte facing bits 4-5 by one direction, preserving all other bits.

label: adrJA0076D2
source_comment: On the loaded floor, set first-byte bit 2 at (13,12) and clear bit 6 at (14,12); record parameters are unused.

label: adrJA0076EA
source_comment: On the loaded floor, clear first-byte bit 2 at (3,0) and set bit 6 at (4,0); record parameters are unused.

label: adrJA007702
source_comment: A6/D0: trigger cell. Set the north-edge closed bit in the cell immediately west if its second-byte bit 7 is clear.

label: adrCd007710
source_comment: Return after checking or closing the wooden door beside the trader pad.

label: adrJA007712
source_comment: A5: party. XOR facing at +$20 with 2 to reverse direction; do not change position or read record parameters.

label: adrJA00771A
source_comment: A5: party. Mask a random value to 0-3 and store the new facing at +$20; position is unchanged.

label: adrJA007728
source_comment: A5: party. Increment facing at +$20 modulo four, matching the normal right-turn control; record parameters are unused.

label: adrJA007734
source_comment: A1/D1: record. Set target first-byte bit 0 and request sound 1; preserve lock data and do not test for a key.

label: adrJA007746
source_comment: A1/D1: record. Clear target first-byte bit 0 and request sound 1; preserve lock data. Switch dispatch subsequently plays sound 0.

label: adrJA007758
source_comment: A1/D1: record. Rotate the target first byte right by two bits, moving each wooden edge one side counterclockwise.

label: adrJA007768
source_comment: A1/D1: record. Clear the target type, then fall through to set first byte 1 and type 3, preserving remaining flags.

label: adrJA00776C
source_comment: A1/D1: record. Set first byte 1 and XOR second byte with 3; normally toggles space/pillar but performs no type check.

label: adrJA00777E
source_comment: A1/D1: record. OR second byte with 6; retain first byte and other flags. Starting types with bit 0 set become type 7.

label: adrJA00778A
source_comment: A1/D1: record. XOR second byte with 6 on the loaded floor; BB is unused and no teleport occurs.

label: adrJA007796
source_comment: BB: movement-vector index from the triggering cell. Toggle neighbour type bits with 6; if out of bounds, remove the record CC/DD target instead.

label: adrJA0077D6
source_comment: A6/D0: triggering cell. Create a pillar one cell north and clear the cell northwest; ignore BB/CC/DD and retain upper second-byte flags.

label: adrJA007800
source_comment: A6/D0: external pad; A5: party. Close the eastern doorway if unoccupied; queue Vivify and search ground remains two cells east, then place/rejoin a champion.

label: adrCd007812
source_comment: A6/D0: revival cell. Queue effect $86; require an unoccupied cell with objects, then scan its four stack corners for remains.

label: adrLp00782A
source_comment: D4: corner 3 down to 0. Find that corner object stack at A6/D0; matching stack returns A0/D7 for its record.

label: adrCd007832
source_comment: Continue the four-corner ground-stack search after a missing stack or no valid remains.

label: adrCd007836
source_comment: Return when the revival cell is occupied, has no objects, or contains no suitable champion remains.

label: adrCd007838
source_comment: A0/D7: object stack. Set A1 to its object pairs and D3 to the last two-byte pair offset.

label: adrCd007844
source_comment: A1/D3: object pair. Accept codes $40-$4F and return their champion number 0-15 in D2.

label: adrCd007854
source_comment: Step D3 back by two bytes; after the first pair, continue with the next ground-stack corner.

label: adrCd00785A
source_comment: Reserve the revival cell, remove the selected remains, recover its floor/X/Y, and find the champion party membership.

label: adrCd00787E
source_comment: D0: champion; D2: packed X/Y; D3: floor. Write champion location/current tower and face west. Returns A4 stat record; swaps D2 words.

label: adrCd0078A0
source_comment: A5: owning party; D1: slot; D0: champion. Clear the dead bit and choose whether the revived champion replaces a dead leader.

label: adrCd0078B6
source_comment: Move the old leader to the revived slot and select the revived champion before installing the new leader.

label: adrCd0078C0
source_comment: D0: champion; D2: X/Y; D3: floor; A5: party. Install and select the new leader, relocate the party and face west.

label: adrCd0078E4
source_comment: Refresh the revived party interface, restore the activating party A5 from the stack and return.

label: adrJA0078F0
source_comment: A6/D0: internal pad; A5: party. Close the western doorway, queue Vivify, play sound once and revive eligible dead party slots with five HP/vitality.

label: adrCd0078FA
source_comment: Queue effect $86 at the pad, play sound 5 now, suppress dispatcher sound, and begin scanning four party slots.

label: adrLp007910
source_comment: D0: slot 3 down to 0. Skip empty/unavailable/living slots; clear dead flag and restore five vitality and hit points for eligible champions.

label: adrLp007940
source_comment: D1: display slot 3 down to 0. Find a negative/free champion-order entry; fall back to slot zero if all are used.

label: adrCd00794C
source_comment: D0: revived party slot; D1: display slot. Keep champion-number bits only and copy the number into the display order.

label: adrCd007958
source_comment: Continue the party-slot loop, then reset party-command/presentation state and refresh the current interface.
